codes.descriptor: understand how texts are made cohesive by using personal and possessive pronouns and by omitting words that can be inferred

elaborations.text: identifying language used to build information across a text; for example, through connecting similar and dissimilar things

tracking how a person or thing is identified through a section of a text; for example, “eggs”, “they”, “them”
identifying words left out that can be inferred from the surrounding text; for example, “Xanthe went to school. She had a lovely day.” (at school is inferred)
using personal and possessive pronouns to link entities previously mentioned in the text

entry_focuses: Track personal and possessive references
Recover understood omitted words
